items.quote: Direct reports said that Liodre Yanira spearheaded engagement with industry stakeholders at the national level.
Peers observed that Liodre Yanira was recognised sector-wide for their leadership of the scenario planning exercise on future workforce needs.
Peers observed that Liodre Yanira took ownership of the partnership with sister agencies on youth services and steered it to completion.
Several respondents noted that Liodre set the direction for drafting legislative amendments for the new act across the public service.
Liodre Yanira handled emergency coordination during the flood response competently within their team.
Direct reports said that Liodre Yanira delivered their share of prototyping novel ideas for frontline staff reliably.
Direct reports said that Liodre took ownership of an ethics review of conflict-of-interest declarations and steered it to completion.
Several respondents noted that Liodre led negotiations with contractors on the service agreement across the department.
Direct reports said that Liodre took ownership of media interviews and press conferences and steered it to completion.
